about_short_description.short_description: CreatorML is a developer of machine learning tools for YouTube creators to optimize video titles and thumbnails.

product.name: View Predictor Tool
product.description: Predicts the performance of YouTube videos before recording by simulating different titles, thumbnails, and video lengths to maximize views and engagement.

product.name: YouTube Video Idea Generator
product.description: Generates video ideas and title suggestions based on trending and high-performing YouTube content tailored to a creator's niche and audience.

product.name: Winning Thumbnail Predictor
product.description: Scores and ranks potential YouTube thumbnails to identify the most effective image for maximizing click-through rates and viewer engagement.

product.name: CreatorML Co-Pilot Chrome Extension
product.description: A Chrome browser extension that provides public analytics, video performance insights, and AI-generated summaries for YouTube videos and channels.

product.name: Video Search Tool
product.description: Allows users to discover over-performing YouTube videos and analyze their public analytics to inform content strategy.
